basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old digital artist and a huge fan of Animal Crossing: New Horizons. I recently got into trading DIY recipes on Reddit, and I love customizing my island. Based in Portland, Oregon, I spend my evenings and weekends online, juggling between my art projects and my new-found love for the Reddit community. I'm single, and when I'm not trading or creating art, I enjoy indie music and exploring local cafes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Fine Arts and have been practicing digital art for over 5 years. I picked up Animal Crossing during the pandemic and became fascinated by the creative possibilities it offers. My knowledge in this area is mostly self-taught, supplemented by community interactions and online tutorials.
